007import java.io.PrintWriter;
008import java.io.StringWriter;
009import java.util.Properties;
010
011import javax.script.Bindings;
012import javax.script.ScriptContext;
013import javax.script.ScriptEngine;
014import javax.script.ScriptEngineManager;
015import javax.script.ScriptException;
016
017import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
018import org.apache.log4j.PropertyConfigurator;
019
020import junit.framework.TestCase;
021
022/**
023 * Test to verify that the JessopScriptEngine properly releases memory after evaluation,
024 * including the underlying GraalJS polyglot Engine.
025 *
026 * <p>Run with: -Xmx512m to make OOM failures visible sooner.
027 */
028public class JessopMemoryLeakTest extends TestCase {
029
030    Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(JessopMemoryLeakTest.class);
031
032    public void setUp() {
033        String logFormatPrefix = "[JessopMemoryLeakTest] ";
034        Properties lp = new Properties();
035        lp.put("log4j.rootCategory", "INFO, CONSOLE");
036        lp.put("log4j.appender.CONSOLE", "org.apache.log4j.ConsoleAppender");
037        lp.put("log4j.appender.CONSOLE.layout", "org.apache.log4j.PatternLayout");
038        lp.put("log4j.appender.CONSOLE.layout.ConversionPattern", logFormatPrefix + "%d{ABSOLUTE} %-5p %c - %m%n");
039        PropertyConfigurator.configure(lp);
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Tests that evaluating jessop scripts via the JessopScriptEngine does not leak memory.
044     * Each eval creates an underlying GraalJS engine with an isolated polyglot Engine;
045     * after eval completes, both the Context and Engine should be closed and memory released.
046     */
047    public void testJessopEvalReleasesMemory() throws ScriptException {
048        long baselineMemory = getUsedMemory();
049        System.out.println("Baseline memory: " + (baselineMemory / 1024 / 1024) + " MB");
050
051        int iterations = 100;
052        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
053            StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
054            PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(sw);
055
056            ScriptEngine engine = new ScriptEngineManager().getEngineByName("jessop");
057            assertNotNull("jessop engine not found", engine);
058            Bindings b = engine.getBindings(ScriptContext.ENGINE_SCOPE);
059            b.put("polyglot.js.allowAllAccess", true);
060
061            ScriptContext context = engine.getContext();
062            context.setWriter(pw);
063            b.put("out", pw);
064
065            // Use a slightly different expression each time to prevent trivial caching
066            String script = "<%= 'hello' + ' ' + " + i + " %>";
067            engine.eval(script, b);
068
069            String output = sw.toString();
070            assertTrue("Expected output containing 'hello', got: " + output,
071                output.contains("hello"));
072
073            if (i % 25 == 24) {
074                System.gc();
075                long currentMemory = getUsedMemory();
076                System.out.println("After " + (i + 1) + " iterations: " +
077                    (currentMemory / 1024 / 1024) + " MB (delta: +" +
078                    ((currentMemory - baselineMemory) / 1024 / 1024) + " MB)");
079            }
080        }
081
082        System.gc();
083        long finalMemory = getUsedMemory();
084        long delta = finalMemory - baselineMemory;
085        System.out.println("Final memory delta: " + (delta / 1024 / 1024) + " MB after " + iterations + " iterations");
086
087        // With isolated engines, delta should be modest (under 100MB for 100 iterations)
088        assertTrue("Memory grew by " + (delta / 1024 / 1024) + " MB after " + iterations +
089            " jessop evals - engines may not be releasing memory",
090            delta < 100 * 1024 * 1024);
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * Tests with varied expressions to simulate real-world usage where each report
095     * has different dynamic content (which creates different shapes in the Truffle engine).
096     */
097    public void testJessopEvalVariedExpressionsReleasesMemory() throws ScriptException {
098        long baselineMemory = getUsedMemory();
099        System.out.println("Baseline memory (varied): " + (baselineMemory / 1024 / 1024) + " MB");
100
101        int iterations = 100;
102        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
103            StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
104            PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(sw);
105
106            ScriptEngine engine = new ScriptEngineManager().getEngineByName("jessop");
107            assertNotNull("jessop engine not found", engine);
108            Bindings b = engine.getBindings(ScriptContext.ENGINE_SCOPE);
109            b.put("polyglot.js.allowAllAccess", true);
110
111            ScriptContext context = engine.getContext();
112            context.setWriter(pw);
113            b.put("out", pw);
114
115            String[] scripts = {
116                "<%= 'report ' + " + i + " %>",
117                "<%= ({name: 'test', value: " + i + "}).name %>",
118                "<%= [1,2,3," + i + "].length %>",
119                "<%= (function(x) { return x * 2; })(" + i + ") %>",
120                "<%= 'item_' + " + i + " + '_end' %>"
121            };
122            String script = scripts[i % scripts.length];
123            engine.eval(script, b);
124
125            if (i % 25 == 24) {
126                System.gc();
127                long currentMemory = getUsedMemory();
128                System.out.println("After " + (i + 1) + " varied iterations: " +
129                    (currentMemory / 1024 / 1024) + " MB (delta: +" +
130                    ((currentMemory - baselineMemory) / 1024 / 1024) + " MB)");
131            }
132        }
133
134        System.gc();
135        long finalMemory = getUsedMemory();
136        long delta = finalMemory - baselineMemory;
137        System.out.println("Final memory delta (varied): " + (delta / 1024 / 1024) + " MB after " + iterations + " iterations");
138
139        assertTrue("Memory grew by " + (delta / 1024 / 1024) + " MB after " + iterations +
140            " varied jessop evals - shared Engine may still be accumulating shapes",
141            delta < 100 * 1024 * 1024);
142    }
143
144    private long getUsedMemory() {
145        Runtime rt = Runtime.getRuntime();
146        return rt.totalMemory() - rt.freeMemory();
147    }
148}
